subject: Request: temporary priority H200 assignment + reservation hold and overage concessions
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@medfusion.ai>
To: rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary priority H200 request + reservation hold and overage concessions

Rohan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We ran the internal sizing and there is a concentrated spike expected across our inference fleet May 1 - May 28 (customer onboarding wave). We are asking Redwood for two temporary concessions so we can avoid losing customers during the ramp:

1) Provision H200 priority assignment for a 6-week window (we currently have H100 reserved).
2) Put our 4-node reserved capacity into a 30-day hold window while the H200 priority is active, with predictable burst capacity (up to 4x baseline) during peak hours.

We also need an overage cap that is lower than standard list overage (our finance team requests a max of 1.6x the committed per-hour rate during the 6-week window). If possible, we'd like a one-time concession on the committed monthly charge for the hold month to help offset onboarding costs.

Attaching the demand forecast and a short ops note. Please let me know what approvals you need and any timing constraints. We are motivated to sign a longer term if this works — willing to discuss a 12-month commitment starting from the new activation date.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Head of Infrastructure
MedFusion.ai
(attachment: MedFusion_Demand_Forecast_Q3.pdf)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Temporary priority H200 request + reservation hold and overage concessions

Team — forwarding MedFusion's ask. Key points: temporary H200 priority for 6 weeks, 30-day reservation hold, burst up to 4x, cap overage at ~1.6x, and a one-off committed-month concession. Prospect indicates willingness to sign 12-month term starting at activation.

Quick internal read: revenue when active remains significant; risk is the non-standard GPU swap + below-list overage cap and holding an existing reservation. I ran a quick forecast (attached MF_Demand_Analysis.xlsx) — expected incremental revenue for May–June is ~$120k, but margin is compression if we accept the 1.6x overage cap.

As this is outside standard pricing and requires GPU-family reassignment, I need an exec sign-off for three items:
- Temporary H200 assignment (6 weeks) and reservation hold (30d)
- Reduce overage multiplier to 1.6x for the window and cap to $10k total overage liability
- One-time 15% credit on the reserved month (or equivalent bill smoothing)

Requesting approval or guidance. If we get a conditional approval, I'll prepare an amendment + DocuSign and confirm PS kickoff dates.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive, Dedicated
Redwood Inference
(attachment: MF_Demand_Analysis.xlsx)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary priority H200 request + reservation hold and overage concessions

Marissa / Karthik —

I reviewed Rohan's analysis and the forecast. Recommendation for deal desk / exec approval:
- Approve a 6-week temporary H200 priority assignment (May 1 — Jun 12), swapping MedFusion's reserved H100 capacity to H200 for the window.
- Allow a 30-day reservation hold starting on May 1 (re-activation date to be confirmed).
- Approve an overage multiplier of 1.5x for the period (slightly better than their ask) and cap our liability at $8,500 total; any consumption above that reverts to standard overage terms.
- Offer a one-time 12% concession on the reserved month's invoice (recognize in deal desk for revenue ops).

Trade-offs / conditions:
- Customer must sign a 12-month committed term effective on activation date and execute the DocuSign amendment before May 1.
- Require weekly health check calls (first 6 weeks) and engagement of PS (billable) — must be scheduled and documented in the MAM.
- Limit applies only to their current 4-node reservation; any additional reservations will be quoted normally.

If this is acceptable to leadership, I will draft the amendment and the HubSpot quote update (DF-2027-113) and loop Legal for a quick addendum.

-Lauren
Director, Sales Ops (Deal Desk)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: APPROVED: Conditional temporary H200 + hold (DF-2027-113)

Thanks Lauren — reviewed and approving with the following explicit conditions:

1) Approve 6-week temporary H200 priority and the 30-day reservation hold as outlined.
2) Approve overage multiplier of 1.5x limited to $8,500 liability during the window. Any overage beyond $8,500 will be billed at standard overage and will require post-hoc review.
3) Approve one-time 10% concession on the held month's committed charge (per finance guidance).
4) Customer must sign the amendment via DocuSign no later than 2027-04-22. If DocuSign isn't back by then, approval auto-reverts and we rescind the H200 assignment.
5) Require a PS kickoff scheduled by 2027-05-01 and weekly ops calls (documented in the MAM).

Revenue ops / Legal: please prepare amendment language that includes the overage cap, the reversion clause, and the 12-month effective commitment starting on the new activation date. Rohan — send the DocuSign link and draft amendment to Lina and copy in Lauren/Karthik.

Marissa Cole
VP, Head of Dedicated Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Lina —

Good news: leadership has approved your request on a conditional basis. Summary of what we can do for MedFusion for the May activation window: 

- Temporary H200 priority assignment for 6 weeks (May 1 — Jun 12) in place of your current H100 reservation.
- 30-day reservation hold tied to the May activation window.
- Overage multiplier set to 1.5x for the window, capped at $8,500 total liability. Anything above that will revert to standard overage billing and is subject to review.
- One-time 10% concession applied to the held month's committed charge.

Conditions for the approval: 1) Signed DocuSign amendment by 2027-04-22; 2) Customer commits to a 12-month term effective on the re-activation date; 3) Weekly ops calls during the 6-week window; and 4) PS kickoff scheduled no later than 2027-05-01.

Next steps: I attached the amendment draft (MF_Temporary_H200_Amendment.docx) and generated the DocuSign link here: https://docusign.com/tx/DF-2027-113-amend. Please review, sign, and I'll coordinate activation and PS scheduling.

Appreciate the quick turnaround, and let me know if you need any changes on the amendment language.

Best,
